title: VeriAgent: A Tool-Integrated Multi-Agent System with Evolving Memory for PPA-Aware RTL Code Generation
problem: RTL generation optimizes correctness without accumulating reusable physical-design optimization experience.
assumption_broken: EDA feedback need not remain transient or optimize correctness alone.
operational_signature: Generate → execute → abstract feedback → update memory → retrieve guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory manager inserts, refines, or discards triggered optimization rules extracted from verification and synthesis trajectories.
limitations_evident: PPA win rates exclude tasks without mutually synthesizable outputs
Memory construction and evaluation separation is unspecified
Baseline PPA comparison uses previously reported results

title: AgentFactory: A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
problem: Textual experience does not reliably reduce repeated effort on complex procedural tasks.
assumption_broken: Reusable experience can be executable subagents rather than prose reflections.
operational_signature: Decompose → generate executable routines → execute → repair → store and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful Python subagents are persisted and repaired against subsequent task feedback instead of reconstructing solutions from textual memories.
limitations_evident: Cost excludes LLM calls inside subagents
Only thirty curated tasks are evaluated
Runtime success does not establish output correctness

title: Learning to Self-Evolve
problem: Off-the-shelf prompt editors are not explicitly trained to extract transferable improvements from task feedback.
assumption_broken: The ability to improve contexts is a trainable skill rather than a fixed byproduct of general reasoning.
operational_signature: Evaluate context → summarize errors → propose edit → reward improvement → branch and revisit
load_bearing_mechanism: Single-step reinforcement learning rewards the downstream accuracy change relative to the pre-edit context.

improver_modified.how: The context-editing policy is explicitly fine-tuned with an improvement-based reinforcement learning objective.

limitations_evident: Best accuracy is selected on the repeatedly reused holdout set
Separate evolution policies are trained for each task domain
Only instruction fields and small environments are studied

title: Beyond Scalar Rewards: Dense Feedback for LLM Policy Synthesis in Sequential Social Dilemmas
problem: Scalar self-play reward aliases different coordination failures requiring opposite policy corrections.
assumption_broken: Auxiliary social metrics can guide reward maximization without being explicit optimization objectives.
operational_signature: Generate policy → validate → self-play → expose diagnostic metrics → rewrite
load_bearing_mechanism: Dense efficiency, equality, sustainability, and peace feedback disambiguates failure modes during code-policy refinement.
limitations_evident: Small environments with homogeneous policies and full state access
Adversarial tests find environment-mutation reward exploits
Independent held-out evaluation seeds are unspecified

title: Hyperagents
problem: Fixed handcrafted improvement mechanisms constrain agent evolution outside domains where task and modification skills align.
assumption_broken: The procedure generating agent improvements can itself be editable rather than an immutable meta-level controller.
operational_signature: Select ancestor → rewrite task and modifier code → evaluate → archive → branch
load_bearing_mechanism: A unified editable hyperagent can modify both its task-solving code and the meta-agent that proposes future changes.

improver_modified.how: The meta-agent's modification-generation and application procedures are part of the same editable program as the task agent.

limitations_evident: Main experiments retain handcrafted parent selection and evaluation
Subjective judge tasks optimize agreement with observed human decisions
Expensive evaluation uses staged screening

title: Polaris: A Gödel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair
problem: Small models cannot sustain unconstrained policy self-repair because reflection histories cause context growth and execution failures.
assumption_broken: Persistent policy repair need not retain extensive raw failures and unconstrained rewrite histories.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose failures → abstract strategies → generate minimal patches → check and integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Compact experience abstraction converts a few failure reflections into localized executable policy patches with bounded integration retries.
limitations_evident: Headline gains select maximum improvements across successful runs
OOM and hallucinated tool calls cause unsuccessful runs
Patch integration checks execution rather than improvement

title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself
problem: A fixed autoresearch proposal loop repeats failed search directions and misses productive hyperparameter changes.
assumption_broken: The search mechanism itself can be discovered and injected at runtime rather than merely tuning its parameters.
operational_signature: Inspect traces → diagnose search bottleneck → specify mechanism → inject code → resume experiments
load_bearing_mechanism: An outer LLM loop writes executable search mechanisms that alter exploration in the inner research loop.

improver_modified.how: The outer loop rewrites the inner loop's proposal and exploration mechanisms through validated Python code injection.

limitations_evident: Outer loops add inference and wall-clock budget
One hardware-specific GPT pretraining benchmark with three repeats
Failed mechanism activation confounds the no-guidance ablation

title: Experiential Reflective Learning for Self-Improving LLM Agents
problem: Agents repeatedly relearn environment-specific tool conventions instead of transferring lessons from past interactions.
assumption_broken: Reusable heuristics can be learned from single attempts rather than contrastive retries or aggregated trajectories.
operational_signature: Execute once → reflect on outcome → store triggered heuristic → rank relevance → inject guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-conditioned LLM retrieval selects actionable heuristics distilled from individual success and failure trajectories.
limitations_evident: One backbone in a fixed simulated mobile tool environment
Conflicting heuristics and retrieval scaling remain unresolved
Outcome feedback is assumed in the primary setup

title: Learning to Commit: Generating Organic Pull Requests via Online Repository Memory
problem: Coding agents produce stylistically alien and redundant changes because repository snapshots omit the conventions revealed by historical edits.
assumption_broken: Repository onboarding should actively compare attempted historical changes with expert diffs rather than rely on static code context.
operational_signature: Attempt historical task → reveal expert patch → contrast differences → update skills → solve future task
load_bearing_mechanism: On-policy contrastive reflection against accepted historical diffs accumulates repository-specific reusable skills.
limitations_evident: Only seven test tasks from one internal repository
Synthetic issues are generated from oracle diffs
Organicity relies partly on LLM judges rather than maintainer acceptance

title: EffiSkill: Agent Skill Based Automated Code Efficiency Optimization
problem: Execution-free code optimizers lack reusable mechanism-level knowledge for composing reliable efficiency improvements.
assumption_broken: Optimization knowledge can be distilled into transferable skills instead of remaining tied to retrieved example programs.
operational_signature: Contrast paired solutions → abstract mechanisms → cluster and distill → retrieve → compose rewrites
load_bearing_mechanism: Slow-to-fast transformations are distilled into Operator Skills and procedural Meta Skills that guide diverse candidate plans.

improver_modified.how: Offline mining constructs Meta Skills that govern diagnosis, operator selection, and plan composition.

limitations_evident: Evaluation is limited to competitive-programming programs
Execution-free generation still uses public execution for candidate ranking
Repeated timings do not measure generation-seed variance

title: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
problem: Hand-designed harnesses and compressed optimizer feedback obscure long-horizon causes of context-management failures.
assumption_broken: A proposer should selectively inspect the full artifact history rather than receive fixed summaries or prescribed parents.
operational_signature: Inspect historical code and traces → diagnose → edit harness → evaluate → retain frontier
load_bearing_mechanism: Filesystem access lets a coding-agent proposer retrieve raw code, scores, and execution traces across all prior harness candidates.
limitations_evident: Only one strong coding-agent proposer is studied
Equal evaluation budgets do not equal proposer token costs
Diagnostic histories can reach millions of tokens

title: Mimosa Framework: Toward Evolving Multi-Agent Systems for Scientific Research
problem: Fixed scientific multi-agent workflows cannot adapt topology and tool allocation to execution failures.
assumption_broken: Agent decomposition and communication topology should be optimized per task rather than fixed in advance.
operational_signature: Discover tools → synthesize graph → execute → judge → mutate and accept
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-guided local edits to prompts, nodes, and edges are accepted when workflow judge scores improve.
limitations_evident: Archive reuse is implemented but never exercised in evaluation
Judge correlation with external benchmark success is unvalidated
Single runs and environment setup differences confound comparisons

title: Meta-TTL: Meta-Learning Self-Improvement Policies for Language Agents
problem: Handcrafted cross-episode update policies fail to reliably teach agents how to adapt from sparse experience.
assumption_broken: The meta-prompt controlling test-time improvement should itself be optimized across training environments.
operational_signature: Run adaptation session → extract facts → reflect on update strategy → revise meta-prompt → validate balanced gains
load_bearing_mechanism: Reflective meta-training selects meta-prompts using task-normalized improvement in weighted learning-curve performance.

improver_modified.how: The outer loop optimizes the meta-prompt governing how the meta-agent rewrites actor prompts between episodes.

limitations_evident: Jericho ID evaluation reuses meta-training games
Adaptation requires repeated resets of the same task
Offline meta-training adds hundreds of adaptation sessions

title: Experience as a Compass: Multi-agent RAG with Evolving Orchestration and Agent Prompts
problem: Static retrieval-agent coordination and generic prompt updates propagate errors across multi-hop reasoning trajectories.
assumption_broken: Both orchestration topology and role-specific behaviors can evolve through semantic feedback without weight updates.
operational_signature: Sample workflows → execute and rank → attribute failures → consolidate insights → revise roles and topology
load_bearing_mechanism: Group-relative trajectory reflection jointly updates a utility-tracked experience library and credit-assigned role prompts.
limitations_evident: Generalization depends on orchestrator backbone capability
Prompt evolution trades exact match against recall on ambiguous questions
Token analysis does not fully establish matched search costs

title: PsychAgent: An Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning Agent for Self-Evolving Psychological Counselor
problem: Static counseling models fail to accumulate longitudinal client context and internalize experience-derived intervention strategies.
assumption_broken: Counseling capabilities can evolve through explicit skill acquisition and subsequent parameter internalization instead of static dialogue imitation.
operational_signature: Recall client context → plan session → sample interventions → score trajectories → evolve skills and fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: High-reward session trajectories both expand a hierarchical therapeutic skill tree and supply rejection fine-tuning targets.

improver_modified.how: Fine-tuning trains skill extraction and management capabilities alongside response generation, with subsequent trajectory internalization updating the shared model.

limitations_evident: Simulated counseling outcomes do not establish clinical effectiveness
Training and evaluation profiles come from the same benchmark pool
Real-world safety and privacy evaluation remains future work

title: A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Metasurface Inverse Design
problem: Turning optical design requests into executable solver-specific optimization programs requires specialized expertise.
assumption_broken: Solver-grounded workflow guidance can evolve in explicit skill files while the model, physics solver, and evaluator remain fixed.
operational_signature: Generate program → simulate → score physical criteria → revise skills → validate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: A meta-agent rewrites persistent skill files using deterministic physical feedback, deploying only higher-ranked validation candidates.
limitations_evident: Parameterized families have known attainable structures rather than freeform topology
Largest transfer gain accesses the held-out device class through validation
No improvement over the near-ceiling starter on fully unseen classes

title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
problem: Fixed evolutionary control limits exploration and knowledge reuse during long-horizon open-ended program discovery.
assumption_broken: Agents can autonomously choose retrieval, local testing, proposals, and memory updates rather than follow preset evolutionary heuristics.
operational_signature: Inspect shared artifacts → explore independently → test and evaluate → record insights → consolidate and redirect
load_bearing_mechanism: Asynchronous autonomous agents coordinate through persistent attempts, notes, and reusable skills with periodic reflection and stagnation reminders.
limitations_evident: Stress tests run until convergence rather than a fixed shared budget
Local pre-evaluation tests complicate evaluation-count efficiency comparisons
Artifact reuse associations do not isolate causal memory effects

title: CoEvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification
problem: One-shot multi-file skill generation lacks reliable dense feedback for discovering robust professional workflows.
assumption_broken: A verifier can evolve alongside skills using observable artifacts and opaque oracle bits rather than fixed tests or revealed answers.
operational_signature: Generate skill → execute → synthesize assertions → diagnose failures → refine skill or escalate verifier
load_bearing_mechanism: An isolated surrogate verifier supplies dense diagnostics and strengthens tests when surrogate success conflicts with the hidden oracle.

improver_modified.how: The surrogate verification test suite is rewritten when opaque oracle feedback exposes its coverage gaps.

limitations_evident: Hidden oracle pass/fail is repeatedly consulted during target-task evolution
No held-out task generalization is established
Initialization requires task-relevant background knowledge

title: Self-Optimizing Multi-Agent Systems for Deep Research
problem: Expert-crafted multi-agent research prompts are costly to adapt across changing tasks and models.
assumption_broken: Minimal role prompts can be automatically optimized to rival long-refined expert prompts.
operational_signature: Select prompt system → execute queries → score rubrics → reflect on role → mutate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: GEPA-style Pareto search uses rubric feedback and execution traces to iteratively optimize individual agent prompts.
limitations_evident: Fifty test queries in one computer-science domain
One model serves as agent, optimizer, and judge
No significance testing is reported

title: SKILLFOUNDRY: Building Self-Evolving Agent Skill Libraries from Heterogeneous Scientific Resources
problem: Scientific procedural knowledge is fragmented across artifacts that agents cannot reliably execute or compose.
assumption_broken: Skill libraries can be automatically mined and reorganized from existing scientific resources rather than manually authored.
operational_signature: Identify coverage gap → mine resources → compile operational contract → test and repair → merge or prune
load_bearing_mechanism: A coverage-tracked domain tree guides resource acquisition while execution, infrastructure, and synthetic tests gate skill retention.
limitations_evident: Internal validity concerns retained skills only, not all mining attempts
Novelty is judged by keyword searches against existing libraries
On-demand skills are constructed for the same target workflows used for evaluation

title: ClawArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Evolving Information Environments
problem: Static agent benchmarks do not test maintaining beliefs and implicit preferences under conflicting evolving evidence.
assumption_broken: Persistent-assistant reliability requires revision and personalization rather than static recall alone.
operational_signature: Expose partial sources → interact → inject updates → revise beliefs → verify grounded answers
load_bearing_mechanism: Hidden scenario truth and staged contradictory updates jointly test conflict resolution, belief revision, and silent preference retention.
limitations_evident: Twelve synthetic scenarios with staged rather than live updates
Some cross-model comparisons use different harnesses
MetaClaw skill-evolution details are not provided in the excerpt

title: Combee: Scaling Prompt Learning for Self-Improving Language Model Agents
problem: Naively parallel prompt learning overwhelms aggregation context and discards valuable specific reflections.
assumption_broken: Prompt learning can scale to many parallel trajectories without sacrificing sequential update quality.
operational_signature: Generate parallel traces → reflect → duplicate and shuffle → hierarchically aggregate → update context
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded-load parallel scans and duplicated shuffled reflections preserve actionable insights during large-batch aggregation.
limitations_evident: Aggregation is not guaranteed associative despite the scan analogy
Controller uses one profiling iteration per candidate batch size
Terminal-Bench evaluation contains only twenty-nine held-out tasks

title: InferenceEvolve: Towards Automated Causal Effect Estimators through Self-Evolving AI
problem: Choosing and composing causal estimators requires expertise and counterfactual outcomes are unavailable for real-data evaluation.
assumption_broken: Complete causal estimation procedures can be evolved as programs instead of selecting among a fixed menu of estimators.
operational_signature: Select estimator → mutate program → evaluate replicates → preserve diverse improvements → freeze and test
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM program evolution searches estimator structures using true-effect metrics or cross-fitted observed-data proxy objectives.
limitations_evident: Semi-synthetic performance may not transfer to real observational data
Dataset-specific evolution does not demonstrate cross-benchmark estimator transfer
Frontier-model benchmark memorization remains possible

title: RoboPhD: Evolving Diverse Complex Agents Under Tight Evaluation Budgets
problem: Expensive validation sweeps consume tight evaluation budgets and limit exploration of complex agent designs.
assumption_broken: Noisy training-set tournament rankings can replace separate validation during evolution while preserving final held-out evaluation.
operational_signature: Compete on sampled examples → update ratings → compare errors → create and refine candidate → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Elo competition reuses training evaluations for both candidate selection and comparative diagnostic feedback.
limitations_evident: GEPA lacks coding-agent tool access supplied to competing optimizers
Evaluation budgets do not equalize all proposer computation
Meta-evolution is supported but not experimentally exercised

title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
problem: Agents redundantly rediscover behaviors and transfer poorly from isolated, limited experience.
assumption_broken: Experience can be distilled by a stronger agent into reusable hierarchical skills rather than relearned independently by every agent.
operational_signature: Collect trajectories → extract hierarchical skills → merge and filter → explore coverage gaps → retrieve and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Planning, functional, and atomic skills separate reusable experience by tool granularity for transfer across agent models.
limitations_evident: Refinement stopping explicitly depends on test performance
Skills depend on stable tool schemas
Some skill combinations hurt weaker models through over-imitation

title: EvolveRouter: Co-Evolving Routing and Prompt for Multi-Agent Question Answering
problem: Routing over fixed agent prompts leaves agent weaknesses uncorrected and fixed collaboration sizes waste computation.
assumption_broken: Agent instructions and routing weights can be jointly adapted instead of treating the agent pool as fixed.
operational_signature: Train router → diagnose influential failures → rewrite selected instructions → validate updates → resume router training
load_bearing_mechanism: Router-weighted failure diagnostics prioritize prompt repairs whose improvements most affect the ensemble.

improver_modified.how: The router whose learned weights prioritize prompt repair is fine-tuned after accepted agent changes.

limitations_evident: Cross-benchmark routing transfer degrades substantially
Agent pool and core reasoning roles remain fixed
Detailed dataset splits are deferred to an unavailable appendix

title: Autopoiesis: A Self-Evolving System Paradigm for LLM Serving Under Runtime Dynamics
problem: Fixed serving policies cannot maintain optimal scheduling and reconfiguration trade-offs as workloads and cluster resources change.
assumption_broken: Serving policy code itself can change online rather than only producing new plans from a fixed algorithm.
operational_signature: Snapshot runtime → synthesize policy variants → evaluate completion time → deploy superior policy → observe drift
load_bearing_mechanism: An asynchronous control plane rewrites serving policies against recent runtime traces without interrupting live execution.
limitations_evident: Synthesis and evaluator details are truncated in the supplied text
Traces include synthetic workload fluctuation patterns
Independent future-trace evaluation is not specified in the supplied text

title: PRIME: Training Free Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution for User-Centric Agent
problem: Gradient-based improvement of multi-turn user-centric agents is costly and difficult to audit or transfer.
assumption_broken: Interaction learning can optimize an explicit experience library instead of model parameters.
operational_signature: Explore interactions → assign turn credit → distill staged experiences → mutate and prune memory → retrieve guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Stage-aware retrieval of successful strategies, failure warnings, and user preferences converts multi-turn experience into actionable guidance.
limitations_evident: All users are simulated by Qwen3-32B
GRPO achieves higher absolute performance
GPU-hour comparison does not clarify GPT-4o distillation and evolution API costs

title: SEARL: Joint Optimization of Policy and Tool Graph Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Sparse outcome rewards and unstructured generated tools limit small agents' credit assignment and reusable problem solving.
assumption_broken: Policy learning and external tool-memory growth can be optimized together, using shared tools rather than identical states to group actions.
operational_signature: Decompose tasks → create and reuse tools → group actions by memory anchors → update policy → consolidate tool graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Memory-anchored step advantages compare actions involving equivalent tools across trajectories to densify credit assignment.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the policy that creates, retrieves, and composes tools as tool memory grows.

limitations_evident: Tool generation overhead hurts simpler mathematics tasks
Many generated tools are too trivial for cross-model reuse
Process rewards may encourage superficial reward hacking

title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver
problem: Procedural fixes discovered during individual user sessions do not accumulate into shared improvements.
assumption_broken: Skills can evolve from pooled cross-user execution evidence rather than remain manually maintained deployment artifacts.
operational_signature: Aggregate sessions → group by skill → diagnose shared patterns → edit or create skills → validate and synchronize
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint reasoning over successful and failed sessions across users identifies reusable repairs while preserving working procedures.
limitations_evident: Only four of six benchmark categories are reported
Single six-day evolution study with eight users and one model
Validation reuses relevant tasks from collected interactions without a specified independent final split
